issues.description: The apply_single_qubit_gate function has inconsistent parameter order: the template declares apply_single_qubit_gate(gate, state, site) while the problem statement and the solution expect apply_single_qubit_gate(state, gate, site). This mismatch will confuse students about the correct argument order and prevent straightforward use of the provided solution patterns and documentation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template signature match the problem statement and solution by changing the template function to def apply_single_qubit_gate(state, gate, site): (state first, gate second). Also update any docstrings or example usages in the template to reflect this parameter order so students are not confused.
